display.name: ConferenceOps: fix discovery capacity
display.description: Runs when the check "Discovery is rejecting searches" fails. Investigates discovery-api with telemetry and, only when discovery capacity is the bottleneck, opens a pull request in DSavaliya-Labs/conferenceops-ai that changes only the discovery replicas or resources in deploy/env/aks/values.yaml (OPS-1). Otherwise it reports the mismatch for a human. Managed as code: observability/dash0/automations/ in that repository; scripts/dash0-apply.sh inserts the prompt from discovery-capacity-fix.prompt.md.
